answer: Each agent locks 70 credits to file one artifact: a stone from a canyon seam. It is logged downstream in the river ledger. Each epoch a pulse proves the stone held; a rented stone cannot pulse for its owner, and two missed pulses burn the bond. Filing costs 40 first, 40+6(k-1) per next, each new stone needing a fresh seam and key. 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 and 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents file once, pay 40, keep the bond.
